Design, implement, and validate process improvements and control strategies for rendering, further processing, and protein-based product lines to increase yield and efficiency. Develop and maintain process documentation including SOPs, process flow diagrams, control plans, and validation records in accordance with GMP, HACCP, and regulatory requirements. Demonstrated ability to lead process improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies; Green Belt or higher preferred. Knowledge of food safety systems (HACCP, GMP) and regulatory requirements (USDA/FDA) applicable to meat and protein production. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis, process control, and troubleshooting (e.g., SPC, root cause analysis).
